source.citation: Çimyapan, Ş. (2024). MSc thesis, Institute of Biotechnology, Gebze Technical University. Advisor: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Müge İşleten Hoşoğlu.
source.received: 2026-10-21, from the GTU Institute of Biotechnology (via B. Altıparmak)
source.transcribed_by: Emre Kaan Şahin, 2026-11-12; checked against the rendered PDF pages

method.extraction: Probe-type ultrasonic homogenizer (Bandelin HD 2070), 9 x 10% cycle, 45-55% power; biomass dispersed in deionized water; centrifuged 10,000 rpm, 40 min
method.response: Total soluble protein in the supernatant (g/L), Lowry method, BSA standard
method.design_actual: Two-factor central composite design (4 factorial + 4 axial + 5 centre runs). Box-Behnken needs at least 3 factors, so the label in the thesis is not correct.
method.not_reported: pH and temperature during extraction; protein content of the biomasses

columns.biomass_coded/time_coded: recomputed from actual values; +-1 factorial, +-1.414 axial

flags.suspect_value: Centre run reads 0.108 g/L while the other four centre runs read 1.099-1.133 g/L. Probably a transcription error (e.g. 1.108). Excluded from models by default (use_in_model = 0) until the raw file confirms the value.
flags.near_zero: 0.0001 g/L at 1.72 g/L biomass; likely below the Lowry quantification limit. Kept, but treat as 'about zero', not as an exact value.
flags.time_level_mismatch: Low time level printed as 5 min for run 10 but 2 min for run 13 (both coded -1); the axial point 2.29 min does not match 12.5 - 1.414 * 7.5 = 1.89 min. Actual values are used as printed.
flags.centre_time_typo: Centre time printed as 12.30 min; the midpoint of 5-20 min is 12.50 min. Value kept as printed (difference is negligible for modelling).
flags.axial_time_asymmetric: Axial times 10.22 and 48.18 min are not symmetric around 27.5 min (a rotatable CCD would give 9.82 and 45.18 min). Values kept as printed.
flags.coded_labels: All tables print axial points as -1/+1; in a CCD they are -1.414/+1.414. The columns *_coded are recomputed from the actual values.
